title: 托福官方套题 04 · 口语

tasks.sample: All computers have the essential software.
This printer is available for students.
Digital scanners can be used for uploading your documents.
When listening to audio, please use the provided headphones.
We also have a charging area over here for your devices.
Before leaving the lab, please log out after you have finished using the computer.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for joining the study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your dietary habits. First, can you describe some of the types of food you or your friends typically eat for breakfast or your first meal of the day?
(Interviewer) I see. Now, imagine that cost is not an issue. Would you prefer to eat home-cooked meals or meals out at restaurants? Why?

(Interviewer) Interesting. Recently restaurants have become more concerned about providing information about ingredients in their food that may cause allergic reactions, like peanuts. Do you think restaurants should be required to provide this information, even if it increases the cost? Why or why not?

(Interviewer) Good points. For my final question, I'd like to ask about the future of food consumption. Meal delivery services have now become quite common, which can affect how often people cook at home. Do you think people will increasingly rely on meal delivery services or pre-packaged meals, or will home-cooked meals remain popular? Explain your thoughts.
